a.lede: President had brushed away suggestions to slow down AI technology, even as his own party counseled caution Donald Trump on Saturday said he would appoint an artificial intelligence czar and create an “AI Force” to help monitor the technology, though he gave almost no details about either plan. As global fears over AI have grown, especially in the past week
a.title: Trump to create ‘AI Force’ to monitor technology as fears over out-of-control agents grow

b.lede: The president offered few details on what his proposed new AI Force would do.
b.title: Trump rejects AI slowdown calls, launches "AI Force" instead
